summary: Revision r12 → r13 has 3 changes: global window, 30 → 60 minutes; query service, checkout-api → payment-svc; series color, blue → teal. Two affect data and one affects appearance. Previews are schematic definitions, not historical telemetry.
constraints: Durable immutable saved revisions are proposed. Existing in-memory undo is not durable persistence.
Restore creates a new guarded revision through a draft using the current ETag, retaining local work on conflicts.
Keep saved-query dependency references separate. Restoring a dashboard does not mutate those definitions.
Missing providers, permissions and history remain explicit. An old definition is not an evidence capture.
